slides.say: For every number x, five times diamond of x, minus three x, is equal to eight plus four times diamond of x. Diamond of four is equal to what?
The diamond is on both sides. It's very rare on the exam, but good to know. [short pause] We treat the diamond like an unknown, and isolate it.
at: The diamond is on both sides

slides.say: [short pause] Move the four diamonds to the left, as a minus, and the minus three x to the right, as a plus. Five diamonds minus four diamonds is one diamond.
So diamond of x is three x plus eight. Now it's an ordinary definition.
Diamond of four is three times four plus eight, twelve plus eight, twenty. Choice number two is our answer. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next question.
at: Choice number two is our answer
